queue.claim: Reallusion Headshot 2 (2023, CC4) has a photo mode and a Mesh mode for any-topology heads, and runs locally. Character Creator 5 shipped in 2025 with a denser head. CC/Headshot licences are perpetual, a few hundred USD each.

queue.claim: R3DS Wrap was rebranded as Faceform and is sold as subscription tiers, including an indie tier with a revenue cap. Its pipeline is point pairs, then rigid alignment, then regularised wrapping, then optional optical-flow wrapping, then texture and blendshape transfer.
